summary: The CohortRotations document pertains to the configuration and management of course rotations within a learning management system. It handles the display, validation, and editing of timetable rotations, including their start and end dates. The document utilizes various web controls, such as Panels, Labels, Buttons, and Validators to manage user interactions and data presentation. It incorporates JavaScript functions for client-side validation and AJAX controls for asynchronous updates.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing cohort rotations within the HSPnet system, allowing for the addition, editing, deletion, and copying of course rotations.

workflows.name: Manage Timetable Rotations
steps: Select a timetable to view rotations.
Add new rotations by entering start and end dates.

validations: Start date cannot be after the end date.
Rotation dates must be within course start and end dates.
Mandatory fields must be completed before saving.
system_behavior: Display panels and messages based on user actions.
Use AJAX for updating parts of the page without a full refresh.
Handle errors and warnings through dedicated panels.
